hero.headline: Indulge in Homemade Happiness: Where Every Bite Tells a Story.
hero.subheadline: From celebration cakes to heartfelt catering, Mamma & Mia brings the warmth of a mother's kitchen to your most special moments in the North West.

services.title: Custom Cake Design
services.description: We specialise in creating beautiful, bespoke cakes for weddings, birthdays, and all of life's celebrations, tailored to your theme and taste.

services.title: Event Catering
services.description: Our full-service catering brings a menu of homemade goodness to your event, from savoury spreads to decadent dessert tables.

services.title: Personalised Consultation
services.description: We work closely with you to understand your vision, offering expert guidance on flavours, design, and menu planning.

services.title: Ongoing Support & Solutions
services.description: We provide reliable service and support, ensuring a seamless and stress-free experience from first contact to final delivery.

testimonials.text: Lety made the most incredible wedding cake for us! It was not only stunning to look at but absolutely delicious. Our guests couldn't stop talking about it.
testimonials.name: Sarah & James

faq.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
faq.answer: We recommend placing your order at least 2-4 weeks in advance, especially for wedding cakes or large events, to ensure availability and detailed design time.

faq.question: Do you cater for dietary requirements?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We are happy to discuss and accommodate various dietary needs, including gluten-free, vegan, and nut-free options. Please mention your requirements during your consultation.

faq.question: What areas in the North West do you serve?
faq.answer: We proudly serve the entire North West province. Delivery charges may apply depending on the distance.

history: Founded by Lety Gibbon, Mamma & Mia Cakes And Catering started from a deep-rooted passion for home baking and bringing joy through food. What began as creations for friends and family blossomed into a beloved local business, built on the same principles of love, quality, and community.
